skill.name: webask-account-audit
skill.description: Проверяет состояние аккаунта WebAsk одним отчётом: брошенные опросы, ненастроенные уведомления, приближающиеся лимиты и место. Применяется, когда человек просит навести порядок, разобраться, что происходит в аккаунте, или выяснить, почему что-то перестало работать.
skill.summary: Review WebAsk surveys, notifications, storage, plan limits, and member access in a prioritized report without changing account data.
skill.author: webaskio

content.value_statement: Inactive surveys, missing notifications, and account limits can leave important responses unnoticed. This skill guides a read-only WebAsk review with prioritized findings and concrete recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Identify published surveys with recent responses but no email recipients or enabled integrations.
Flag inactive published surveys and old drafts, while asking about seasonal use.
Review storage consumption and files hidden because of quota limits.
Check survey, response, and email usage against account plan limits.
Review pending invitations and potentially excessive member access.
Organize findings by urgency with affected object counts and concrete next steps.
limitations: Requires access to the listed WebAsk MCP tools and permission to read the relevant workspace data.
Produces recommendations only; it does not delete surveys, change permissions, or configure notifications.
Prioritizes integration checks for surveys with recent responses rather than checking every survey.
Cannot establish seasonal intent or necessary member permissions without business context.

use_cases.title: Find Missing Response Notifications
use_cases.description: Review active surveys for missing email recipients or integrations that could leave incoming responses unnoticed.

use_cases.title: Prepare Account Maintenance
use_cases.description: Identify old drafts, inactive surveys, and storage pressure before planning approved cleanup work.

use_cases.title: Review Workspace Access
use_cases.description: Summarize pending invitations and potentially excessive permissions for review with team owners.

prompt_templates.title: Get an Account Overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my WebAsk account and summarize the most urgent findings. Do not change or delete anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: request a general account review.

prompt_templates.title: Check Response Notifications
prompt_templates.prompt: Find published surveys with recent responses but no email recipients or enabled integrations. Report the affected surveys and recommended next steps without changing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Review Capacity and Inactivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review storage, hidden files, plan limits, old drafts, and inactive published surveys. Ask about seasonal surveys before labeling them abandoned. Report counts without recommending upgrades.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Prioritized Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit notifications, survey activity, capacity, invitations, and member access. Prioritize current operational impact, include affected counts, and propose specific actions. Flag uncertain access needs for confirmation. Make no changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine operational and access findings.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Check whether recent survey responses have notification recipients.
output: Example finding: Delivery Feedback received 47 responses this month, with no email recipients or enabled integrations.
Priority: Review these responses and confirm who should receive future notifications.
The settings alone do not establish whether anyone has read the responses.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review account maintenance priorities.
output: Example inventory: 34 surveys against a limit of 50, including 11 older drafts.
Storage: 82% used, totaling 3.4 GB, mainly respondent uploads.
Activity: Two published surveys have no responses since April; confirm whether they are seasonal.
Access: One invitation remains unaccepted; confirm whether access is still needed.
Next steps: Review draft owners, storage growth, and the pending invitation. No changes were made.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace and use authorized access to the WebAsk MCP tools.
Provide seasonal schedules and member responsibilities before judging survey inactivity or permission needs.
Review findings with account owners and approve any follow-up changes separately.
anti_patterns: Treating the audit as permission to delete surveys or change account settings.
Assuming missing notifications prove that responses were lost or unread.
Labeling seasonal surveys abandoned or recommending plan upgrades instead of reporting observed limits.

faq.question: What does the audit inspect?
faq.answer: It reviews surveys, notification settings, integrations, storage, plan limits, invitations, and member access.

faq.question: Does the skill change my account?
faq.answer: The instructions explicitly prohibit changes and deletions during the audit. The output is a report with recommended actions.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Your assistant needs a configured WebAsk MCP connection exposing the listed tools and authorized access to the workspace.

faq.question: Does it check every survey integration?
faq.answer: No. It prioritizes surveys with recent responses when reviewing integrations and email settings.

faq.question: How does it handle seasonal surveys?
faq.answer: It should ask about seasonal use before treating an inactive survey as abandoned.

faq.question: Will it recommend a more expensive plan?
faq.answer: No. The instructions require reporting reached or approaching limits without recommending a plan change.
